title: PostgreSQL 19 released with WAIT FOR LSN for standby reads
summary: PostgreSQL 19 is out, roughly two months later than the project&\#x27;s usual September release; the delay was attributed mainly to issues the team handled amid a wave of AI-reported vulnerability reports. The release adds WAIT FOR LSN, which lets a session on a standby wait until that standby has replayed WAL up to a specified log sequence number before running a query, enabling read-your-writes consistency for applications that send reads to replicas. Applications can capture pg\_current\_wal\_insert\_lsn\(\) after a write and later issue WAIT FOR LSN with an optional timeout, which returns an error if the replica does not catch up in time.
